# ImGuizmo

This directory contains the unmodified ImGuizmo source pair and MIT license from
[upstream commit e552f632bbb17a0ebf5a91a22900f6f68bac6545](https://github.com/CedricGuillemet/ImGuizmo/tree/e552f632bbb17a0ebf5a91a22900f6f68bac6545).
EditorUI builds the gizmo against its pinned Dear ImGui version. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
